trigger: a type-17 structure with Length < 0x20 and a size word of 0x7FFF
classification_rationale: the plan's unknown-is-never-concrete rule maps size 0x7FFF to the Extended Size field; the code synthesised a concrete capacity when that field is absent. Gate-time grade SHOULD kept; the recorder derives LOW because the only production caller (the firmware_posture adapter) reads type 0 and discards the type-17 result, so the wrong capacity cannot reach an output (E6)
summary: Type 17 Size 0x7FFF with Length < 0x20 decoded to 32,767 MiB instead of nullopt, pinned by a test expectation. Raised independently by Kimi (LOW) and Codex (MEDIUM). Fixed in b9a81454d: 0x7FFF is handled independently of Length, with an unknown capacity (populated stays true) when the Extended Size dword is absent, and the test expectation now says nullopt.
